npcdefault.htm.text: I have nothing to say to you

Q00134_TempleMissionary/30067-01.htm.text: Priest Glyvka: Our order steadfastly obeys Einhasad's will even in the face of persecution and chaos. We share with the nobility the desire to preserve order wherever possible. I ask you, adventurer: in obedience to the goddess, are you willing to prove yourself a servant of order?

Q00134_TempleMissionary/30067-02.htm.text: Priest Glyvka: You are not yet ready to serve Einhasad in the war against chaos. (Only characters level 35 and above are permitted to undertake this quest.)

Q00134_TempleMissionary/30067-04.html.text: Priest Glyvka: Then listen carefully... North of Dion Village lie the Cruma Marshlands. It is said that once the Cruma was a gigantic creature that was born at the creation of the world. None of its remains exist anymore, however.

Q00134_TempleMissionary/30067-07.html.text: Priest Glyvka: Seek out Luke, the spellbook seller , and then vanquish both the monsters bred from the chaos of the Cruma Marshlands and the apostates who have been seduced by the Giants' ancient heresy.

Q00134_TempleMissionary/30067-09.html.text: Priest Glyvka: We serve Einhasad, the goddess of light, order and power. Eons ago, Einhasad imprisoned Shilen, the evil goddess of death. She also destroyed the Giants, who in their arrogance and corruption sought to dethrone the gods themselves. The people of this continent long served Einhasad in…

links.text: "I understand. I will help as much as I can."

Q00134_TempleMissionary/30067-08.html.text: Priest Glyvka: You have successfully accomplished your mission? Einhasad be praised! Now you have become the feet of our Temple. Listen carefully to what I am about to tell you...

Q00330_AdeptOfTaste/30067-01.html.text: Priestess Glyvka: So you are the one helping Jonas. He told me that he needs Swamp Moss for his cooking. Swamp Moss is very refreshing and many people enjoy eating it, but it is very hard to find. It only grows in cold and damp places deep in the Cruma Swamp. But I know an easier way of getting thi…

But it would be a much better dish if you could get twenty bundles of brown moss ... How about if you try a little harder to find the brown moss?

Jonas will be able to create a wonderful dish from this brown moss. He's had so many failures in the past ... I hope he can finally receive ack…

If the moss is carried around for too long, it becomes limp and loses its fresh flavor. Please hurry and deliver it to Jonas.

Q00134_TempleMissionary/30067-05.html.text: Priest Glyvka: When the Giants rebelled against the goddess, they captured Cruma and imprisoned it in order to experiment on it. Bound with massive steel chains, the Cruma could only move across a very limited area. Over time, it wore down the earth in that spot and water seeped in, resulting in th…

Q00134_TempleMissionary/30067-06.html.text: Priest Glyvka: Patience... The monsters who inhabit the Cruma Marshlands were also the twisted creations of the Giants' so-called science. Abandoned and isolated, there must be a large number of them by now. These creatures by their very existence are violations of the order established by Einhasad…

Q00134_TempleMissionary/30067-10.html.text: Priest Glyvka: Then accept this badge, which shows that you are the feet of our Temple. Other citizens should learn from your example... If you also become the hands of the association, you will be awarded the title of the limbs of the association ... To become the hands of the Temple, seek out Pri…

Q00330_AdeptOfTaste/30067-04.html.text: Priestess Glyvka: Yes. Please continue in your efforts. If you can get twenty bundles of brown moss, I will prepare them well for you. Jonas' dish will become even more astounding. As I explained before, in order to gather the swamp moss, you must go to the Cruma Marshes and hunt gray or giant crim…

Q00330_AdeptOfTaste/30067-05.html.text: Priestess Glyvka: I understand. I will go ahead and prepare the twenty bundles of green moss you have brought me It would be best if we could provide brown moss for Jonas ... But since we are short on time, we have no other choice. You won't be needing the rest, so I'll take them. Here, all done. I…

ai/npc/Trainers/HealerTrainer/30067-note.text: Priestess Glyvka: Do you need a place to rest? If so, you may rest in this temple ... But if you have come to learn something, there is nothing I can teach you. After you refresh a little, go find a Master who shares your path.

ai/npc/Trainers/HealerTrainer/30067.html.text: Priest Glyvka: Let the love of Mother Einhasad enfold you, my child. Leave your struggle behind and enter into the peace of the true faith. Only then will you find refuge from the evil and chaos that surrounds us...

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
